environment.scene: studio fixture (47.5 m², 2 rooms, 9 items) plus a hand-drawn 3.2 m² room

manualObservations: Built-in studio loads with GLB furniture, walls, doors and windows in 3D and top view.
Catalog card click shows size/clearance summary; double-click adds a free-position item (v1→v2).
Undo removes the added item and produces a new server version (v2→v3); redo becomes available.
Top-view freehand room: 4 snapped points + first-point click created a 3.2 m² room (v3→v4).
Wall e0 selection + add door created a 0.90×2.10 m door (v4→v5); width/swing edits committed (v5→v7).
Dragging the sofa snapped to 0.1 m and committed one version (v7→v8); undo enables.
Vertex input edit changed the room polygon, server re-anchored the door and the UI showed the opening_reanchored warning toast (v8→v9).
Furniture selection shows kind/variant/size/position/rotation/room/constraints and a PointContext badge.
knownLimitations: Catalog HTML5 drag/drop was verified by code path and client precheck tests, not by a synthetic native drag in the in-app browser.
The +Z front axis is recorded in the source manifest and visually checked in the editor; the asset validator measures AABB/pivot but cannot infer orientation automatically.
Door clearance and collision validation are delta-based for manual edits; legacy fixture furniture is not re-litigated on load.
Solver is a spike only; scoring, beam search and L-shaped rooms are M4 work (ADR-0008).
